title: Call the API directly with curl
caption: The portal is the normal client, but every operation can be called on loopback with a Bearer token. Without the BFF headers the end-user IP is the socket address.

steps.title: Sign up
steps.expect: `202 {"status":"verification_sent"}` (same answer for an existing address). Row in `platform.accounts` with `status = 'pending_verification'`; e-mail `auth.verify_email` in Mailpit.

steps.title: Verify the address
steps.body: Copy the `token` query value of the link in Mailpit, then `POST /v1/auth/verify-email {"token":"…"}`.
steps.expect: `200`; `accounts.status = 'active'`, `email_verified_at` set; `account_tokens.consumed_at` set. A second use answers `400 VERIFICATION_TOKEN_INVALID`.

steps.title: Sign in
steps.expect: Without MFA: `PortalSession` with `accessToken` (15 min) and `refreshToken`. With MFA: `{mfaRequired: true, mfaChallengeToken, expiresIn}`, then `POST /v1/auth/mfa/verify {mfaChallengeToken, code}`.

steps.title: Call an operation
steps.expect: `200` JSON. Errors use `{"error":{"code","message","status","requestId"}}`; quote the `requestId` in bug reports.

steps.title: Refresh
steps.expect: A new pair; presenting the old refresh token again answers `401 REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED` and revokes the family.
